overview: You went on without stopping to the castle wall at Flint and a king coming down. You stayed in the chair. The leaf ends while he is still coming down. The second candle guttered while you were still seated.

parties.name: William Shakespeare
parties.context: Wrote the coming down, and ended the leaf there.

assets.name: Richard II
assets.disposition: Wrote Flint and a king coming down

summary: Wrote Flint and a king coming down
